Racing needs at least a Club membership, though one day and seven day event licences exist for a first try. Helmets are compulsory in both states, and summer training shifts to early morning.
synonyms: do i need a licence to race a bike

categories.name: Community Gardens
categories.description: Shared plots, individual beds, compost bays and working bees, usually on council land held under a licence by an incorporated association. That association registers with NSW Fair Trading or Consumer Affairs Victoria depending on the side of the border, which is why fees and rules differ between towns twenty minutes apart. Summer here runs hot enough to kill unshaded seedlings, so ask what the watering roster looks like in January and whether the site has shadecloth.
synonyms: how do i get a plot at a community garden
community garden wagga wagga waiting list

categories.name: Neighbourhood Houses
categories.description: Adult education classes, playgroups, community lunches, tax help and rooms hired out cheaply to whoever needs them. The name is a Victorian one: Neighbourhood Houses Victoria is the peak body for close to 400 member organisations, while the same kind of place on the NSW side is usually called a neighbourhood centre or community centre. That matters when searching, because a Wodonga house and an Albury centre do much the same work under different labels. Programs run in terms, so the February timetable is not the July one.
synonyms: where can i hire a cheap community room

categories.name: Chess Clubs
categories.description: Weekly club nights, rated tournaments, rapid and blitz events and junior coaching, usually in a hall or library room hired for the evening. The Australian Chess Federation publishes the national rating lists and works through seven state bodies, so a Wodonga player sits under Chess Victoria and an Albury player under the NSW Chess Association. Chess Victoria affiliates more than fifteen clubs statewide, so travel is part of playing seriously from here. Ratings only move at rated events, so ask which nights are rated.
synonyms: where can i play chess in person

categories.name: Running Clubs
categories.description: Track sessions, cross country, road races and Saturday morning bunch runs, with clubs registering members through Athletics NSW or Athletics Victoria. Athletics Victoria splits the year into a winter cross country series and a summer track league, and Athletics NSW runs its own calendar, so a border runner sometimes holds both memberships. Summer training here shifts to before six in the morning, and winter means head torches and frost on the Ovens valley flats.
synonyms: how do i start running with a group

categories.name: Service Clubs
categories.description: Rotary, Lions, Apex and Zonta clubs: a regular meeting, often over a meal with a guest speaker, and money raised for local projects. Lions Australia counts more than 1,200 clubs and 25,000 members nationally. Most local clubs are incorporated associations, registered with NSW Fair Trading in NSW and Consumer Affairs Victoria across the river, so two clubs in the same corridor file different paperwork. Membership skews older in the smaller towns, and several meet at a pub or bowling club.

categories.name: Greengrocers
categories.description: Seasonal fruit and vegetables, bulk orders and the cut lines that cafes and caterers run through. Stock follows the season, not the shopfront: stone fruit, berries and chestnuts come out of the Ovens and Goulburn valleys in summer and autumn, and by late winter most of it is trucked up from the Melbourne Market at Epping. Victorian shops register with their council under the Food Act 1984, and New South Wales shops notify their details under the Food Act 2003. Worth asking which growers a shop buys direct from, because that is where the price gap shows.
synonyms: fruit and veg shop open sunday
where to buy local fruit and veg

categories.name: Delis
categories.description: Smallgoods sliced to order, cheese, olives, continental groceries, sandwiches over the counter and platters for a wake or a work function. The corridor carries more of this than its population would suggest, because the tobacco farms of the Ovens Valley and the migrant reception centre at Bonegilla left Italian and Greek families here for three generations. Cheese and cured meat often come from Milawa and the King Valley rather than a national wholesaler. A counter that cuts to order will say when the wheel or the leg was opened.
synonyms: how much is a catering platter

categories.name: Bottle Shops
categories.description: Packaged beer, wine, spirits and cider, plus ice, kegs and cellar door pickups. The licence is a packaged liquor licence, issued by Liquor & Gaming NSW on one side of the river and Liquor Control Victoria on the other, and the conditions on each are set separately. Victorian packaged liquor licences cannot trade on Good Friday unless the licence says otherwise, so Easter hours are worth checking rather than assuming. Shops worth a detour stock Rutherglen fortifieds, King Valley prosecco and Beechworth or Tumbarumba whites alongside the national brands.
synonyms: what time do bottle shops close

categories.name: Health Food Stores
categories.description: Bulk wholefoods, refills, gluten free lines, sports supplements and practitioner only ranges kept behind the counter. Naturopathy and nutrition are not registered professions under the national scheme Ahpra administers, so what is offered across the counter is retail advice rather than regulated health advice. Freight and turnover set the range: a regional shop cannot hold everything, slow lines get ordered in, and bulk bins only stay fresh where trade is steady. Price per hundred grams rather than per tub shows what a small shop is actually charging.

categories.name: Bookshops
categories.description: New releases, special orders, second hand stock, school booklists and the local history shelf the chains do not carry. A title that is not on the shelf usually means several days on a truck from a Melbourne or Sydney distributor, so ordering early matters more here than in a capital. The larger shops sit in Albury and Wagga Wagga, and smaller towns often run their books out of a newsagency or a gift shop. Author talks and standing book club orders carry a share of the trade that a city shop would take in walk-ins.
synonyms: where to buy school booklist books
how long does a book order take

categories.name: Florists
categories.description: Bouquets, funeral tributes, wedding work and standing orders for offices, hospitals and aged care. Most stems come up from the flower markets at Epping or Flemington, so a bouquet ordered on a 40 degree February day arrives in worse shape than the same one in June, and a florist who says so up front is worth keeping. Mother's Day and Valentine's Day book out because a handful of shops cover several towns. National order sites take the booking, keep a cut and pass the job to whichever local florist is free.
synonyms: how much do funeral flowers cost

categories.name: Nurseries
categories.description: Tubestock, advanced trees, seedlings, potting mix, mulch and the advice that stops the wrong plant going in the wrong spot. Altitude does more work here than the state line: what survives a summer at Corowa or Yarrawonga is not what survives a winter at Beechworth or Tumbarumba, and the frost hollows along the valleys catch out anyone planting citrus. Bare rooted fruit trees and roses land in July and August and the good stock goes before the end of winter. Larger yards double as landscape suppliers and deliver soil and mulch by the cubic metre.
synonyms: what to plant in a frost hollow

categories.name: Bike Shops
categories.description: Servicing, wheel and drivetrain work, e-bike diagnostics, kids bikes and hire fleets. Demand runs on the trails: the Murray to Mountains rail trail, the Beechworth and Yackandandah networks and the summer season at Falls Creek and Mount Buller fill workshop books from spring, so a service booked in November can be a fortnight out. Footpath rules split at the river, with children riding footpaths until 16 in New South Wales and until 13 in Victoria, which changes what a first bike gets used for.
synonyms: how much is a bike service
can kids ride on the footpath

categories.name: Outdoor Stores
categories.description: Hiking, camping and fishing gear, snow clothing, boot fitting, gas canisters and chain hire. Snow chain rules are set separately by the Victorian alpine resorts and by the park authority in Kosciuszko, they change with conditions through the declared season, and drivers are fined for not carrying or fitting chains as directed. The gap between the two sets of rules is what sends people back down the hill. Chains are usually picked up in the valley towns on the way up rather than at the snowline.
synonyms: do i need snow chains for falls creek

categories.name: Music Shops
categories.description: Guitars, drums, keys, PA gear, school band instruments and the hire agreements that go with them. School programs are the backbone: brass and woodwind go out on rental in February and come back in December, and a repad or a valve job waits on a technician who covers several towns on a circuit. PA and lighting hire for club functions, weddings and balls is usually the same counter. Albury and Wagga Wagga hold the stock, so smaller towns tend to order through a teacher rather than see it on a wall.
synonyms: where to get a clarinet repadded

categories.name: Art Supplies
categories.description: Canvas and stretcher bars, acrylics and oils, brushes, papers, and often the framing to go with them. Selling spray paint to anyone under 18 is an offence under the Graffiti Control Act 2008 in NSW and the Graffiti Prevention Act 2007 in Victoria, so cans are usually kept behind the counter rather than on an open shelf. Archival paper and roll canvas tend to be ordered in by the metre. Paint and mediums left in a hot car through a Riverina January do not come back.
synonyms: can you buy spray paint under 18

categories.name: Jewellers
categories.description: Repairs, resizing, battery and band changes, remodelling old gold, and valuations for insurance. Buying second hand jewellery or scrap gold needs a second hand dealer licence from NSW Fair Trading, or registration with the Business Licensing Authority in Victoria, whose register Consumer Affairs Victoria publishes. Benches have thinned out across the corridor, so a resize or a full service is often posted away and comes back in weeks. Insurers want a written valuation naming the stone and the metal, not a counter estimate.
synonyms: how much does ring resizing cost

categories.name: Clothing Stores
categories.description: Workwear and hi vis, school uniforms, race day and ball season, and the winter layers the alpine end of the corridor genuinely needs. Care labelling on clothing and textiles is compulsory under the Australian Consumer Law. Consumer guarantees still cover faulty stock whatever a no refunds sign claims, though change of mind is up to the shop. Country ranges are ordered months ahead, so the middle sizes thin out late in a season and are not restocked.
synonyms: where to buy a formal dress
can a shop refuse a refund

categories.name: Gift Shops
categories.description: Homewares, candles, cards, small jewellery and the work of local makers, with the busy run stretching from the spring shows through to Christmas. Gift cards sold since November 2019 must last at least three years, show the expiry date and carry no post purchase fees, a national rule under the Australian Consumer Law. A card for a single small shop is only worth what that shop is still open to honour, which is worth a thought in a town with one of everything. Most will wrap and post.
synonyms: where to buy a birthday present

categories.name: Toy Shops
categories.description: Blocks, bikes, board games, puzzles and the birthday present bought on a Saturday morning. Toys for children up to and including 36 months fall under an ACCC mandatory standard covering small parts, and battery compartments must be secured so they open only with a tool. Separate button battery standards have been mandatory since June 2022. Regional Christmas stock is ordered months ahead and is not restocked in December, so the shelf in late November is close to the whole story.
synonyms: are button batteries safe in toys

categories.name: Produce Stores
categories.description: Stockfeed, hay, animal health lines, fencing, poly pipe, troughs and dog food, for hobby blocks as much as for farms. Feeding restricted animal material to cattle, sheep, goats or deer is banned nationally, so any bag containing it carries a do not feed to ruminants statement and staff will ask what the animal is. Swill feeding to pigs is a separate offence in both states. Hay price and quality swing with the season and the freight, and in a dry year the load comes from further away.
synonyms: what to feed chickens in winter
where to buy bulk dog food

categories.name: Hardware Stores
categories.description: Timber, fixings, fencing wire, paint tinting, key cutting, plumbing bits and the gas bottle swap. LPG cylinders carry a stamped test date and cannot legally be refilled once they are ten years past it, which is why swapping is quicker than chasing a retest. Special order timber, sheeting and steel come in on a weekly run from Albury, Wodonga or Wagga rather than off the floor. Outdoor timber is priced by treatment level, and H4 in-ground rated stock is not always on the rack.

categories.name: Furniture Stores
categories.description: Lounges, beds, mattresses, dining settings and the flat pack in between. Since 4 May 2025 an ACCC information standard has required toppling warnings and anchoring instructions on entertainment units, and on bookcases, drawer units, sideboards and display cabinets 686mm or taller. Second hand pieces sit outside it, which is the argument for anchoring an old dresser anyway. Delivery to the smaller towns runs on set days rather than on demand, and an ordered lounge can take months.
synonyms: how long does a custom lounge take
how to anchor a bookcase to the wall

categories.name: Craft Stores
categories.description: Yarn, quilting cottons, haberdashery, beads and the classes that fill the back room through winter. Fabric cut from the bolt is not coming back over the counter, and consumer guarantees do not cover change of mind, so the measurement is the customer's risk. Sewing machine servicing is thin across the corridor and usually means a travelling technician or a box posted away, so who repairs a machine matters as much as who sells it. Show season and the quilting groups carry the trade.
synonyms: wool and yarn shop near me

categories.name: Beauty Salons
categories.description: Waxing, facials, brows and lashes, manicures, spray tans and skin treatments. The rules differ across the river: in Victoria every beauty therapy premises registers with its local council under the Public Health and Wellbeing Act 2008, while in NSW the trigger is skin penetration work, notified to the council under the Public Health Regulation 2022 and covering cosmetic tattooing, dermal needling, piercing and electrolysis. Waxing and facials alone sit outside the NSW scheme.
synonyms: how far ahead to book for a ball

categories.name: Serviced Apartments
categories.description: One and two bedroom apartments with a kitchen, a laundry and a weekly rate, taken up by contractors, locum health staff and families in town for hospital stays. Servicing is often weekly rather than daily and reception can be a keypad, so late arrivals need arranging in advance. Victoria's short stay levy of 7.5 per cent reaches stays under 28 consecutive days but not premises run as commercial accommodation, so how a building is operated decides whether it appears on the bill. Stock is thin, and one project crew can hold a building for months.

categories.name: Indoor Play Centres
categories.description: Soft play frames, ball pits, ninja courses and toddler zones, with a cafe attached because the adults stay on site. These are not child care: supervision stays with the parent, and most centres say so in their conditions of entry. Grip socks are required almost everywhere and sold at the counter if you forget. Wet winter afternoons and school holidays are the crush, and party rooms book out weeks ahead because few venues run them.
synonyms: indoor activities for kids on a rainy day
how much is an indoor play centre

categories.name: Swimming Clubs
categories.description: Squad training, club nights, carnivals and learn to swim classes feeding into the squads, run out of a council pool rather than one the club owns. Swimming Australia works through Swimming NSW and Swimming Victoria, so a club in Albury and a club in Wodonga register their swimmers with different bodies and swim different state championships. Most outdoor 50 metre pools in the smaller towns close over winter, so clubs chasing a full year in the water share a 25 metre indoor pool and race short course until spring.
synonyms: how much is swim squad a term

categories.name: Wreckers
categories.description: Dismantling written off and end of life vehicles and selling the parts over the counter or freighted out. A yard buying vehicles in New South Wales holds a motor vehicle recycler licence and has to display it where you can read it from the gate, and a Victorian yard turning over more than four cars a year needs a licensed motor car trader number. Neither state permits a recycler to pay cash for a vehicle or a part. Ask what warranty the part carries and whether the yard can search other yards for stock before you drive to Wagga for it.

categories.name: Auto Parts Stores
categories.description: Counter trade in new parts, filters, fluids, batteries and consumables, usually with a trade account for local workshops and an overnight run from a Melbourne or Sydney warehouse for anything not on the shelf. In a corridor this far from either capital the question that matters is what is actually in stock today, because an overnight part is a day of workshop time. Stores that machine discs and press bearings on site save a second trip.

categories.name: Scrap Metal Recyclers
categories.description: Weighbridge trade in ferrous and non ferrous metal: steel, copper, brass, aluminium, batteries and car bodies. Cash has been illegal in this trade on both sides of the river since 1 March 2017 in New South Wales and 30 May 2018 in Victoria, so payment is by transfer and you will be asked for identification. Prices move with the world scrap market and change week to week, which is why a yard quotes on the day rather than publishing a rate.

categories.name: Car Removal
categories.description: Collecting unregistered, damaged and end of life vehicles, usually free, and paying for the hulk by weight and salvageable parts. Despite the wording of every advertisement on the subject, a licensed operator in either state pays by bank transfer rather than cash. Before it goes you need to cancel the registration and lodge the notice of disposal yourself, because the plates and the liability stay with you until you do.

categories.name: Mobile Mechanics
categories.description: Servicing and repairs done in your driveway or at the work site instead of a workshop. It suits logbook services, batteries, brakes and diagnostics, and it does not suit anything needing a hoist, a press or a wheel alignment. On the border the useful ones cover both sides of the river, which matters when you live in Wodonga and work in Albury. Confirm whether the quoted price includes the callout and what happens if the job turns out to need a workshop.

categories.name: Vehicle Inspections
categories.description: Safety inspections before registration. The two states do this differently and it catches people out constantly: New South Wales wants an annual eSafety check, the pink slip, on any light vehicle over five years old, while Victoria has no annual test and asks for a roadworthy certificate only when a car changes hands, comes back onto the register or clears a defect notice. A station is authorised by its own state, so an Albury pink slip is not a Wodonga roadworthy and neither substitutes for the other.

categories.name: Brake and Clutch
categories.description: Disc machining, pad and rotor replacement, clutch and flywheel work, handbrake adjustment and brake line repairs. A shop that machines discs on site rather than sending them out turns a two day job into an afternoon, which is the whole reason to use a specialist instead of a general workshop. Towing and heavy trailer work is the usual reason a border ute goes through brakes early, so mention the van when you book.

categories.name: Transmission Specialists
categories.description: Automatic and manual gearbox diagnosis, rebuilds, torque converters, transfer cases and differentials. Modern automatics need a fluid service on a schedule most owners have never been told about, and sealed for life usually means sealed until it fails. Rebuild or replace is a real decision at this end of the state, because a reconditioned unit freighted from Melbourne can beat a rebuild on both time and price. Ask for the warranty in writing and whether it covers labour.

categories.name: Radiator Repairs
categories.description: Radiators, intercoolers, heater cores and fuel tanks, recored or replaced. It is a hot country trade: a marginal cooling system that behaves all winter fails towing a van up the Hume in February. Recoring an older or unusual radiator is often cheaper than a replacement nobody stocks, and a shop with its own tank bench can do it. Have the cap and the thermo fan tested at the same time, because they tend to fail in the same week for the same reason.

categories.name: Auto Air Conditioning
categories.description: Regassing, leak testing, compressor and condenser replacement in cars, trucks and tractors. Anyone handling refrigerant needs an Australian Refrigeration Council licence, and the number is worth asking for, because topping up a system that leaks is venting gas rather than fixing a car. Demand here is fiercely seasonal, so a November booking beats a January breakdown. Older vehicles on early refrigerants need a conversion rather than a refill.

categories.name: Engine Reconditioning
categories.description: Machine shop work: head skimming and pressure testing, boring and honing, crank grinding, and full engine rebuilds. Regional workshops send this work out rather than doing it in house, so the reconditioner is often the actual bottleneck on a big job. Agricultural and older commercial engines keep these shops alive out here long after the metropolitan ones closed. Ask what is machined on site and what is subcontracted, because that decides the timeline.

categories.name: Auto Upholstery
categories.description: Auto trimmers: seat retrims, headlinings, carpets, convertible tops, ute canopies and tonneaus, and the marine and caravan work that fills the gaps between cars. A sagging headlining and a split driver bolster are the two jobs that come through the door most. The same shops usually cover boat covers and camper canvas, which in a river and lake district is most of their year.

categories.name: Car Washes
categories.description: Automatic tunnels, self serve bays and hand wash operators. Self serve bays are the ones that matter in a farming district, because they take a ute, a horse float and a boat and a tunnel will not. Water restrictions bite here in a dry summer, and a commercial wash that recycles its water is usually still trading when washing at home is not.

categories.name: Car Dealers
categories.description: New franchise dealerships and used car yards. Licensing differs across the river: a New South Wales dealer holds a motor dealer licence from Fair Trading and a Victorian one holds a licensed motor car trader number from Consumer Affairs Victoria, and both states publish a register you can check the number against. A dealer sale carries statutory rights a private sale does not. Run a PPSR check before money changes hands either way.

categories.name: Motorcycle Dealers
categories.description: Road, trail, farm and quad bike sales with the parts counter and workshop attached. Agricultural bike sales carry this trade through towns too small to keep a road bike dealer, and a farm bike is a different machine on a different service interval. Learner approved model rules are set state by state, so a bike a New South Wales learner may ride is not automatically legal for a Victorian one.

categories.name: Caravan and RV Repairs
categories.description: Servicing, insurance repairs, water ingress, brakes and bearings, gas and 240 volt work, and the annual check before a trip. Gas and electrical work on a van has to be done by a licensed gas fitter and a licensed electrician, and the certificate behind it is not optional. This corridor sits on the road between Melbourne and the Queensland run, so booked out is the normal state of a good workshop from March onward.

categories.name: Trailer Sales and Repairs
categories.description: Box trailers, tandems, car carriers, stock crates and float repairs, plus the bearings, couplings, lights and brake controllers that keep them registered. A trailer over 750 kilograms loaded needs its own brakes, and the plate on the drawbar is what an officer reads at the roadside. Local builders who weld and register on site are worth finding, because a repaired chassis usually needs an engineer rather than a shop.

categories.name: Boat and Marine Services
categories.description: Outboard and stern drive service, hull and trailer repairs, electronics and boat sales. The Murray, Lake Hume and Lake Mulwala carry this trade, and the towns around them keep marine mechanics that inland towns of the same size do not have. Boat licensing and registration are state matters, so a New South Wales licence and a Victorian one are separate documents even on the same stretch of the same river.

categories.name: Battery Specialists
categories.description: Starting, deep cycle, truck, marine and solar batteries, usually with free testing and fitting and a trade in on the old one. Heat kills a battery faster than cold does, so a marginal one fails here in February rather than July. Dual battery and lithium setups for touring and farm use are where this trade has grown. A lead acid battery is worth money as scrap, which is why nobody should be charging you to take the old one away.

categories.name: 4WD Accessories
categories.description: Bull bars, suspension lifts, canopies, drawers, long range tanks, winches, roof racks and dual battery systems, fitted rather than posted. Fitting is the reason to use a local shop: a bull bar has to keep the airbag sensors happy and a lift has to be certified before it is legal. The two states apply the national vehicle standards differently on lift height and tyre size, so a certificate issued on one side of the river is worth checking before you cross it.

categories.name: Truck and Trailer Parts
categories.description: Heavy vehicle parts: brakes and drums, air and suspension components, lighting, couplings, and hydraulic hose made up while you wait. The Hume is the busiest freight corridor in the country and the businesses along it exist to keep a truck out of a two day layover. After hours and weekend counter access is the thing worth knowing before you need it, so ask now rather than at eleven on a Saturday night.

categories.name: Small Engine Repairs
categories.description: Mowers, ride ons, chainsaws, brushcutters, generators, pumps and post drivers, sold and serviced. The season decides the wait: everybody books a mower service the week the grass takes off in September and a chainsaw service the week before a fire ban, and both queues are weeks long. Firewood country and a real fire season make the chainsaw side of this trade busier here than the mower side.

categories.name: Farm Machinery Dealers
categories.description: Tractors, headers, balers, side by sides and implements, with the parts counter and field service that come with them. Choosing the dealership matters more than choosing the machine out here, because a header down in a harvest window is measured in days of lost crop rather than dollars of repair. Ask how many field service utes the branch runs and how far it will travel. Parts availability for an older model is the question that decides resale.

categories.name: Metal Fabrication
categories.description: Engineering workshops doing structural steel, sheet metal, stock crates, gates, machining and repair welding, in the shop and out on the farm. The regional version of this trade is defined by what it fixes rather than what it makes, because the alternative to a repair is freight from Melbourne and a fortnight of waiting. Aluminium and stainless need a different setup to mild steel, so ask what the shop actually runs before you cart something in.

categories.name: Equipment Hire
categories.description: Tool, plant and access hire: excavators, scissor lifts, concrete gear, augers, trenchers and scaffold, and party equipment in the yards that do both. A weekend rate that runs Friday afternoon to Monday morning for one day of hire is the thing worth asking about. Delivery and pickup pricing is where a cheap day rate stops being cheap, and a wet weather clause matters where a paddock job can stop for a week.

modifiers.label: Emergency
modifiers.intro: Listed here when the business answers after hours and attends the same day for burst pipes, sewer overflows and no water. After hours rates are higher than the day rate and the figure appears on the listing where the operator has supplied it.

modifiers.label: Blocked drains
modifiers.intro: Qualifies when the plumber runs their own drain camera and jetter instead of sending the work elsewhere. Tree root intrusion is the usual cause in older streets and the camera is what proves it.

modifiers.label: Hot water
modifiers.intro: For plumbers who repair and replace electric, gas, heat pump and solar units and hold stock for a same day swap. A dead system on a Sunday is the most common reason people search this.

modifiers.label: Gas fitting
modifiers.intro: Listed when the plumber holds a gas fitting authorisation for natural gas and LPG, which is separate to a plumbing licence. Covers appliance installation, leak repairs and compliance certificates.

modifiers.label: 24 hour
modifiers.intro: For electricians who take calls overnight and on weekends for power failures, burning smells and a switchboard that keeps tripping. After hours work is charged from the moment they leave the depot.

modifiers.label: Switchboard upgrades
modifiers.intro: Qualifies when the electrician does full board replacements, including removing ceramic fuses and fitting safety switches to every circuit. Plenty of housing stock in both states still runs a board that predates RCD requirements.

modifiers.label: Extensions
modifiers.intro: For builders who take on additions, second storeys and structural renovation rather than new builds only. Extension work needs engineering, an approval pathway and a tie in to an existing structure, which is a different job to a slab on a clear block.

modifiers.label: Ducted
modifiers.intro: Listed when the business designs and installs ducted refrigerated systems, not only wall splits. Ceiling space, zoning and duct sizing decide whether a ducted system actually performs on a 40 degree day.

modifiers.label: Split system
modifiers.intro: For installers who supply and fit wall mounted splits, including back to back and long pipe runs. Quotes move on run length and any electrical work needed, so a site look beats a phone price.

modifiers.label: Battery storage
modifiers.intro: Qualifies when the installer sizes and fits home batteries alongside solar, including retrofits to an existing array. Battery work carries its own accreditation and rules about where the unit can be mounted.

modifiers.label: Mobile
modifiers.intro: For mechanics who come to the house, the yard or the paddock in a fitted service van. Useful for fleet servicing and for anything that cannot be safely driven to a workshop.

modifiers.label: Diesel
modifiers.intro: Listed when the workshop does diesel work in house, covering DPF cleaning, injector testing and turbo replacement. Diesel utes and light trucks run the regional fleet and not every shop is set up for them.

modifiers.label: Mobile
modifiers.intro: For auto electricians working from a fitted service vehicle rather than a workshop bay. Standard for farm, fleet and roadside jobs where the machine cannot be moved.

modifiers.label: Mobile fitting
modifiers.intro: Qualifies when the business fits and repairs tyres on site, including truck and agricultural work in a paddock. Harvest and freight breakdowns are the whole reason this service exists.

modifiers.label: Mobile
modifiers.intro: For fitters who bring the glass and the gear to a home or worksite. Most chip repairs and many full replacements are finished in a driveway inside two hours.

modifiers.label: End of lease
modifiers.intro: Listed when the cleaner does bond cleans judged against the entry condition report, oven, window tracks and blinds included. Ask whether a free return visit is covered if the agent knocks it back.

modifiers.label: Carpet cleaning
modifiers.intro: For cleaners running their own hot water extraction plant rather than a hire machine from the supermarket. Usually booked with a bond clean, or after a flood or a pet accident.

modifiers.label: Commercial
modifiers.intro: Qualifies when the business holds contracts for offices, schools, medical rooms and shops, which brings insurance, police checks and after hours access with it. Different scheduling and different compliance to a house clean.

modifiers.label: Interstate
modifiers.intro: For removalists who run loads across the border and beyond rather than local moves only. A cross border job is priced per move because the truck is committed for a full day or more.

modifiers.label: Termite inspections
modifiers.intro: Listed when the technician carries out full timber pest inspections to the Australian Standard and issues a written report with photographs. That is separate work to a general spray and worth repeating every twelve months.

modifiers.label: 24 hour
modifiers.intro: For locksmiths attending lockouts and break in repairs overnight and on weekends. A regional callout includes travel, so ask what the fee covers before they leave.

modifiers.label: Stump grinding
modifiers.intro: Qualifies when the business owns a grinder instead of subcontracting the job out. Access width is the first question, because a narrow side gate rules out the bigger machines.

modifiers.label: Emergency
modifiers.intro: For arborists who attend storm damage after hours, including limbs on roofs and trees across a driveway. Anything touching a powerline goes to the network operator first, not a contractor.

modifiers.label: Rural fencing
modifiers.intro: Listed when the contractor builds boundary, internal and stock fencing on farms and quotes by the kilometre. Covers post driving, strainer assemblies, gates and the spacings that suit cattle or sheep.

modifiers.label: Pump outs
modifiers.intro: For operators with a licensed vacuum truck and an approved disposal point for the waste. Most households need a tank pumped every three to five years depending on size and use.

modifiers.label: Mobile
modifiers.intro: Qualifies when the workshop sends a service truck to the property for field breakdowns. Response time during sowing and harvest is the only thing that matters on this page.

modifiers.label: Dog friendly
modifiers.intro: For cafes that let a dog sit with you outside, with a water bowl at the door. Food safety rules keep dogs out of indoor dining areas in both states, so this always means the courtyard or the footpath tables.

modifiers.label: Open Sunday
modifiers.intro: Listed when the cafe trades on Sundays, which is not a given in a country town where the main street shuts. Hours are re-checked weekly and the listing shows when they were last confirmed.

modifiers.label: Gluten free
modifiers.intro: For kitchens with real gluten free dishes and a process for keeping them apart, not a salad offered as an afterthought. Coeliac diners should still ring ahead about cross contamination in a shared kitchen.

modifiers.label: BYO
modifiers.intro: Qualifies when the restaurant lets you bring your own wine, with or without corkage. Common in smaller towns where a full liquor licence is not worth the cost to the operator.

modifiers.label: Outdoor seating
modifiers.intro: For venues with a courtyard, verandah or footpath tables, which matters from October through April. Shade in summer and heaters in winter decide whether the space is usable at either end.

modifiers.label: Kids menu
modifiers.intro: Listed when there is a proper children's menu rather than a smaller plate of an adult dish. High chairs and a change table are recorded on the listing where we have confirmed them.

modifiers.label: Gluten free
modifiers.intro: For bakeries producing gluten free bread and sweets, which in a shared bakery is never coeliac safe. Ask which day the gluten free lines are made, since most bake them in a batch rather than daily.

modifiers.label: Open Sunday
modifiers.intro: Qualifies when the shop trades Sunday, which in a lot of towns leaves it as the only thing open after midday. Sunday surcharges apply at some venues and are noted where known.

modifiers.label: Beer garden
modifiers.intro: For pubs with a real outdoor area rather than two tables near the bins. Shade, heaters and whether the kitchen serves out there are recorded where we have confirmed them.

modifiers.label: Live music
modifiers.intro: Listed when the pub books live acts on a regular night rather than once a year for a fundraiser. Most country venues run Friday or Saturday and the usual night appears on the listing where the venue has told us.

modifiers.label: Pokies
modifiers.intro: For venues with a gaming room on site. Machine numbers are capped differently in NSW and Victoria, and both states require responsible gambling signage and access to self exclusion.

modifiers.label: Courtesy bus
modifiers.intro: Qualifies when the venue runs a courtesy bus around the local area, which is why a lot of country pubs stay busy on a Friday. Nights of operation and the pick up radius vary, so ring on the day.

modifiers.label: TAB
modifiers.intro: For pubs with a TAB outlet or terminals and the racing vision on screen. Usually paired with a Saturday crowd and a counter lunch.

modifiers.label: Kids menu
modifiers.intro: Listed when the bistro runs a children's menu and can seat a family without fuss. Playgrounds and high chairs are noted on the listing where they have been confirmed.

modifiers.label: Courtesy bus
modifiers.intro: For clubs running a bus that collects and drops members and guests inside the town. Standard on bistro nights and worth booking early in the evening rather than at closing.

modifiers.label: Dog friendly
modifiers.intro: Qualifies when dogs are welcome in the outdoor drinking area. Common at regional taprooms working out of sheds and yards where most of the seating is outside anyway.

modifiers.label: Live music
modifiers.intro: Listed when the bar programs live acoustic or jazz on a set night. Small rooms fill fast on a music night, so a booking is the sensible move.

modifiers.label: Pet friendly
modifiers.intro: For motels that take dogs, usually in specific ground floor rooms and often for a small extra charge. Rules about leaving an animal alone in the room differ, so confirm that when booking.

modifiers.label: Family rooms
modifiers.intro: Qualifies when the motel has rooms sleeping four or more in the one space instead of forcing two bookings. Interconnecting rooms are recorded separately where they exist.

modifiers.label: EV charging
modifiers.intro: Listed when there is charging on site for guests, whether a destination unit or a dedicated outlet. Connector type and speed decide whether an overnight stop actually fills the car, so both are recorded where confirmed.

modifiers.label: Powered sites
modifiers.intro: For parks with powered caravan and camper sites, with the amperage shown where we have it. Powered sites sell first over school holidays and long weekends.

modifiers.label: Pet friendly
modifiers.intro: Qualifies when dogs are allowed on sites, in cabins, or both, which are three different policies. Many parks suspend pet bookings over school holidays even when they allow them the rest of the year.

modifiers.label: Dog friendly
modifiers.intro: For campgrounds that permit dogs, which rules out almost every national park site in both states. State forest, Crown land reserves and privately run camps are where this is possible.

modifiers.label: Pet friendly
modifiers.intro: Listed when the property takes dogs inside or in a secure yard. Fencing and whether the dog can be left alone while you go out are the two things to settle before booking.

modifiers.label: Dog friendly
modifiers.intro: For cellar doors that welcome dogs in the outdoor areas, which covers most working vineyards and few of the restaurant sites. Leads are expected and the property's own working dog gets right of way.

modifiers.label: Open Sunday
modifiers.intro: Qualifies when the cellar door trades on Sunday, which not every small producer does. Weekday opening at boutique sites is often by appointment only, so the listing shows both.

modifiers.label: Wheelchair accessible
modifiers.intro: Listed when there is step free entry, an accessible toilet and room to move between displays. Heritage buildings are the usual obstacle, and partial access is described on the listing rather than claimed as full.

modifiers.label: Pram friendly
modifiers.intro: For tracks with a firm, mostly flat surface that takes a pram or a wheelchair. Rail trails and sealed riverside paths make up most of what lands here.

modifiers.label: Junior program
modifiers.intro: For clubs fielding junior sides and running age group coaching, with registration opening before the autumn start. Fees, training nights and whether uniforms are supplied are recorded where the club has told us.

modifiers.label: Junior program
modifiers.intro: Qualifies when the club fields junior sides or runs an entry level program for primary school ages. Sign ups happen through August and September ahead of an October start.

modifiers.label: Come and try
modifiers.intro: Listed when the club runs open sessions for beginners, with bowls supplied and no membership needed. Barefoot nights count and are the easiest way to work out whether you like it.

modifiers.label: Come and try
modifiers.intro: For clubs that get newcomers on the water without owning a boat, either through a learn to sail course or as crew on someone else's. Most run these in spring before the summer racing season.

modifiers.label: Junior program
modifiers.intro: Qualifies when the club runs rallies and instruction for riders under 18, which is the core of what pony club does. Whether a rider needs their own horse or can borrow one is noted on the listing.

modifiers.label: Free pickup
modifiers.intro: Listed here when the yard collects the vehicle at no charge rather than expecting it delivered. Free pickup usually assumes the car is complete and reachable by a tilt tray, so say up front if it is behind a shed or missing its wheels.

modifiers.label: Parts warranty
modifiers.intro: Qualifies when the yard states a warranty period on used parts. A written warranty on a second hand engine or gearbox is the difference between a bargain and a gamble, and the yards offering one say so on their own site.

modifiers.label: 4WD and ute
modifiers.intro: For yards that specialise in four wheel drives and utes rather than passenger cars. Body panels, trays, diffs and transfer cases are the parts people drive across the border for, because a wrecked ute is worth more in pieces than most sedans are whole.

modifiers.label: Trade delivery
modifiers.intro: Stores that run a delivery to workshops rather than making the mechanic leave the hoist. In a corridor with two capitals a day away, a local run at ten and two is what stops a car on a hoist becoming a car in the yard.

modifiers.label: Takes car bodies
modifiers.intro: Yards that weigh in complete car bodies, not only separated metal. Payment is by bank transfer in both states and you will be asked for identification, which is the law rather than the yard being difficult.

modifiers.label: Delivers
modifiers.intro: Hire yards that deliver the machine and collect it afterwards. On a rural block the delivery fee often decides the hire, because a five tonne excavator is not going behind a ute.

modifiers.label: Pickup and return
modifiers.intro: For shops that collect the mower or the ride on and bring it back. A ride on will not fit in a hatchback and that is the whole reason this service exists.

modifiers.label: Both sides of the river
modifiers.intro: Mobile mechanics who attend in both New South Wales and Victoria. On this border that is an ordinary working day rather than an unusual service, and it is why a Wodonga driveway and an Albury car park are the same job.
